assertion: On Sept 24, 2026, Chu, Sherman, Schiff, and Padilla sent a follow-up letter to FEMA demanding immediate action to stop DCMP from shutting down Sept 30, calling on FEMA to grant California's appeal and approve $6,568,265.60, following FEMA Region 9's Sept 11, 2026 denial and an unanswered Sept 10 prior letter. DCMP has an approved total award of ~$13M over 24 months, only ~$3M released, serving 3,000+ survivors including 1,288 active cases.
article_value: Letter sent 9/24/2026 by named lawmakers; $6,568,265.60 denied 9/11/2026; unanswered 9/10 letter; ~$13M/24-month award, ~$3M released; 3,000+ survivors, 1,288 active cases
warehouse_value: AskAmerica's disasters schema confirms DR-4856-CA (WILDFIRES AND STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, declared 2025-01-08) and the related FM-5549/5550/5551 fire-management declarations (Palisades/Eaton/Hurst) as the governing FEMA disaster numbers, but carries no DCMP-specific case-management program data -- that program detail is outside the corpus and was verified against primary sources instead.
independent_value: Confirmed verbatim against the full letter text reproduced in Rep. Chu's Sept 24, 2026 press release, and independently corroborated by Pasadena Now's Sept 27, 2026 reporting citing the same letter plus additional independent sourcing (Eaton Fire Collaborative).

sql: SELECT DISTINCT disaster_number, fema_declaration_string, declaration_title, incident_type, declaration_date, ih_program_declared, pa_program_declared FROM disasters.disaster_declarations WHERE state_fips = '06' AND declaration_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-01' ORDER BY declaration_date

assertion: As of June 2026, more than $177 million has been paid to 35,000+ households via FEMA Individual/Household Assistance for the Eaton and Palisades Fires.
article_value: $177M+ paid to 35,000+ households, as of June 2026
warehouse_value: Not available in the corpus -- disasters.disaster_declarations carries only a boolean ih_program_declared flag (individual assistance activated Y/N), not dollar or household-count figures for the Individuals and Households Program. This is a genuine sourcing gap, reported rather than proxied.
independent_value: Confirmed verbatim: Rep. Chu's June 24, 2026 press release states 'As of June 12, 2026, FEMA reported that more than 35,000 households have received assistance through the Individuals and Households Program, with more than $177 million awarded to eligible survivors.'

assertion: As of September 2026, $2.5 billion or more in FEMA public-assistance projects for the Eaton and Palisades Fires remain pending.
article_value: $2.5B+ in FEMA PA projects pending, as of September 2026
warehouse_value: disasters.public_assistance_projects for DR-4856-CA: 318 funded-project records, total project_amount ≈ $45.2M, total federal_share_obligated ≈ $36.6M, all 'Active' status -- no figure remotely near $2.5B. Zero PA project records at all for the three FM declarations (Palisades/Eaton/Hurst fire-management assistance).
independent_value: California Governor's Office (gov.ca.gov), May 8, 2026: 'California desperately needs FEMA to release more than $732 million in Public Assistance funding...approved at the regional level but still awaiting final sign-off approval from DHS Headquarters. Only $37 million has been obligated' -- out of $1.5B in submitted PA claims. This $37M closely corroborates the warehouse's own $36.6M obligated figure. No source located anywhere (FEMA.gov, CA Governor's Office, congressional offices, or news coverage May-Sept 2026) ties a $2.5B figure to FEMA Public Assistance for these fires; the only $2.5B figure found in coverage of these fires is Governor Newsom's separate, state-administered wildfire relief fund (unrelated to FEMA PA). The best-documented, most recent genuine FEMA PA pending figure is $732M (May 2026 vintage) -- about 3.4x smaller than claimed, and four months earlier than the claimed September 2026 date.

sql: SELECT disaster_number, project_status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(project_amount) proj_amt, SUM(federal_share_obligated) fed_obl FROM disasters.public_assistance_projects WHERE disaster_number IN (4856,5549,5550,5551) GROUP BY disaster_number, project_status ORDER BY disaster_number
